_doc: Budgets checked by tests/perf_probe.gd (medians over 180 frames of the fixed clearing scene: day 1 11:00, clear, camera at the porch spawn, yaw 45, pitch -48, dist 27, far 70). GPU timings (frame_ms_*) are only enforced when enforce_gpu is true: under xvfb + llvmpipe they are meaningless. See ARQ v2 §17.1 / §18.

before_m0.note: Committed pre-M0 slice (GodotPhysics, v1 assets with one StandardMaterial3D per palette colour, camera far 260, CPUParticles3D). Measured with tests/perf_probe.gd on the untouched copy.

after_m0.note: M0: Jolt, v2 assets (COLOR_0 + palette_vcol -> shared world_vcol ShaderMaterial), camera far 70, no shadows on small props / interior furniture, GPUParticles3D. draw_calls_max = 60 % of before_m0 (PLAN M0 acceptance).
